body.purpose: Card text and form fields; 1rem minimum on inputs to prevent iOS zoom.

label.purpose: Form labels and muted metadata; always Label Warm or Muted Warm.

micro.purpose: Hebrew dates and chips inside calendar cells; floor is 0.72rem.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Separates white cards from the parchment field; the only shadow in the system.

motion.name: hover-brighten
motion.purpose: Instant hover feedback on primary buttons — no transition, phone-first UI.

breakpoints.name: container
breakpoints.purpose: Max content width; the app is one phone-first column at every viewport.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The affirmative action — שמירה, הוספה. Walnut fill, ≥44px tall.
components.css: .ds-btn { font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; background: #6d5c44; color: #fff; } .ds-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: default; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Toggles, dismissals, +שבוע. Stone fill; hover shifts to Stone Hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; background: #eee9e0; color: #2d2a26; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #e3dac9; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Danger Ghost Button
components.description: מחיקה only. Transparent + Late Red text; never the biggest control on a card.
components.css: .ds-btn-danger { font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; background: transparent; color: #b3261e; } .ds-btn-danger:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #fbe4e2; } .ds-btn-danger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: White field on Field Edge, 44px tall, 1rem text (no iOS zoom). Label sits above in Label Warm.
components.html: <label class="ds-label" for="ds-f">שם</label><input class="ds-input" id="ds-f" placeholder="שרה כהן">
components.css: .ds-label { display: block; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; color: #5c544a; margin: 12px 0 4px; } .ds-input { font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; padding: 10px 12px; min-height: 44px; border: 1px solid #d8d0c4; border-radius: 10px; background: #fff; color: #2d2a26; width: 100%; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Loan Card
components.description: White paper card on parchment, 1px edge, faint warm lift. Overdue variant tints the whole card.
components.html:
שרה כהן באיחור 3 ימים
להחזרה: 23.9 — א׳ בתשרי
רחל לוי באיחור 3 ימים
components.css: .ds-card { font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: #2d2a26; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e6e0d6; border-radius: 12px; padding: 14px 16px; margin-bottom: 10px; box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgba(80,66,45,0.08); } .ds-card-overdue { border-color: #e5a09a; background: #fdf6f5; } .ds-muted { color: #6f665a; font-size: 0.85rem; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-badge-late { display: inline-block; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; background: #fbe4e2; color: #b3261e; }

components.name: Status Badges
components.description: Pills carrying the app's three meanings: late, returned, caution/visitor.
components.html: באיחור 3 ימים הוחזר מבקר
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; padding: 2px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 600; } .ds-late { background: #fbe4e2; color: #b3261e; } .ds-ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1e7a3c; } .ds-warn { background: #fdf0e0; color: #7c4a00; }

components.name: Return Notice with Undo
components.description: OK Wash confirmation bar; the undo action lives inline, exactly where the mis-tap happened.
components.html: ✓ חזר למלאי — שרה כהן
components.css: .ds-notice { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; background: #e6f4ea; color: #1e7a3c; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 14px; margin-bottom: 10px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-undo { font-family: inherit; font-size: inherit; min-height: 0; padding: 4px 10px; background: transparent; border: none; color: #1e7a3c; font-weight: 700; text-decoration: underline; cursor: pointer; } .ds-undo:hover { color: #145c2e; }

components.name: Tab Bar
components.description: Three equal-width tabs; inactive Stone, active Walnut. role=tablist, aria-controls wired.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; gap: 8px; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-tab { flex: 1; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; border: none; border-radius: 10px; padding: 10px 18px; min-height: 44px; cursor: pointer; background: #eee9e0; color: #2d2a26; } .ds-tab:not(.ds-active):hover { background: #e3dac9; } .ds-tab.ds-active { background: #6d5c44; color: #fff; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Quantity Stepper
components.description: −/+ Stone buttons flanking a centered count — replaces typed number input for phone use.
components.css: .ds-qty { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 6px; } .ds-qty-btn { width: 44px; height: 44px; padding: 0; border: none; border-radius: 10px; background: #eee9e0; color: #2d2a26; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 1.2rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; } .ds-qty-btn:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #e3dac9; } .ds-qty-btn:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-qty-val { min-width: 28px; text-align: center; font-weight: 600; font-size: 1.05rem; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; color: #2d2a26; }

components.name: Calendar Day Cell
components.description: Real button, 64px tall: civil number, Hebrew date, one chip. Shabbat/chag get washes; today gets a 2px Walnut ring.
components.css: .ds-cal { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); gap: 4px; max-width: 320px; font-family: "Segoe UI", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; } .ds-cell { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 64px; background: #fff; color: #2d2a26; border: 1px solid #e6e0d6; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px; font-size: 0.8rem; text-align: start; cursor: pointer; } .ds-cell:hover:not(:disabled) { border-color: #c9bfa8; } .ds-cell:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #6d5c44; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-cell.ds-today { border-color: #6d5c44; border-width: 2px; } .ds-cell.ds-shabbat { background: #efe7d8; } .ds-num { display: block; font-weight: 600; font-size: 0.8rem; } .ds-hday { display: block; font-size: 0.72rem; color: #6f665a; white-space: nowrap; overflow: hidden; } .ds-chip { display: block; font-size: 0.72rem; border-radius: 4px; padding: 1px 4px; margin-top: 2px; overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-chip-ok { background: #e6f4ea; color: #1e7a3c; } .ds-chip-shabbat { background: #e4dbcb; color: #5c544a; }

narrative.overview:
The cloths this app tracks exist for one moment: a table set for Shabbat, a simcha, a family meal. The design borrows that warmth — parchment background, walnut brown, the colors of folded linen — but stays quiet about it. This is a working tool used one-handed on a phone, often mid-conversation at the door. Warmth lives in the palette; the structure stays out of the way.

Everything is soft and thumb-friendly: 44px touch targets, gently rounded cards, generous padding, one column. The visual hierarchy serves a single job — who has what, and is it late — so the only loud elements are the status colors: red for overdue, green for returned, amber for caution.

The app speaks Hebrew, runs RTL, and treats the Jewish calendar as data, not decoration — Shabbat and chagim are visibly shaded, Hebrew dates appear next to civil ones, and due-date picks warn when they land on a holy day.
keyCharacteristics: Warm parchment field, white paper cards, walnut actions
Status color carries all urgency; chrome stays calm
One narrow column (720px max), phone-first, RTL throughout
Tactile minimums: 44px targets, 10–12px radii, visible focus

rules.name: The Status-Only-Color Rule
rules.body: Red, green, and amber appear only where they carry meaning — overdue, returned, caution. Never use them decoratively; a red heading that isn't about lateness breaks the app's one signal.

rules.name: The Dual-Date Rule
rules.body: Anywhere a civil date appears, the Hebrew date appears with it — same line or directly beneath, in Muted Warm. Never show 23.9 alone when the app knows it's א׳ בתשרי.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Depth comes from the background/surface contrast and 1px borders — reserve shadows for the card lift; never add drop shadows to buttons, badges, or chips.

dos: Do keep every touch target ≥44px (the .btn-sm per-item exception aside — it stays inline, never primary).
Do pair every civil date with its Hebrew date in Muted Warm.
Do keep Muted Warm (#6f665a) as the darkest allowed muted text — it passes 4.5:1 on both Parchment and Card Paper.
Do shade Shabbat and chagim on any date-related surface; a due date on a holy day should always get a Warn hint.
Do put undo inside the confirmation notice, not in a separate dialog.
Do keep the interface Hebrew and RTL end-to-end, including error strings.
donts: Don't use Late Red, OK Green, or Warn Amber decoratively — status colors mean status.
Don't add shadows beyond the card lift; depth is tonal layering.
Don't introduce a second accent or a display typeface; Walnut and Segoe UI are the whole voice.
Don't shrink calendar in-cell text below 0.72rem or muted text below #6f665a — both floors were hit and fixed once already.
Don't put a destructive action at primary weight; danger stays a ghost.
Don't put bare confirm()-style friction on reversible actions while irreversible deletes share the same affordance — friction follows reversibility.
